scope: Source-inspection artifact integrity only; not upstream execution, module tests, performance or runtime correctness.

source_hash_checks.method: Pinned recursive Git tree blob SHA equals GitHub connector blob SHA equals local git hash-object

whitespace_checks.method: git diff --no-index --check /dev/null on REPORT.md, public-ledger.json, coverage.json, source-manifest.json, nonpublic local notes (not distributed)

limits: Line-range checks establish file/anchor integrity, not semantic truth or completeness.
42 reviewed files have exact partial ranges, not whole-repository coverage.
Current active and historical Letta pins are deliberately distinct.
Existing Proteus/Modules/examples baseline was read-only; no old proof or sibling module tests rerun.
No external tools, browser actions, model calls, dependency installs, hooks or upstream suites executed.
